_comment: MCP is the one genuinely cross-tool surface, but each tool reads it from a different path. Claude Code: .mcp.json in a project, or `claude mcp add`. Codex: ~/.codex/config.toml under [mcp_servers.NAME]. Cursor: .cursor/mcp.json or ~/.cursor/mcp.json. Augment: ~/.augment/settings.json. Intent: configured in app settings, not from a repo. Never commit credentials here; reference an environment variable instead.
